# NoC Feature Inventory

Inventory of NMU / NSU / ROUTER features defined in `noc_function_blocks.json`. 
The JSON does not drive codegen of internal unit classes; 
this file is documentation + a drift gate.

Column **Expected c_model header** points to the conventional path for that 
feature's c_model implementation. Existence is **not enforced** — some features 
may not have an implementation yet.

## NMU — Network Master Unit

_Role_: AXI-side injection / response sink

| Feature ID | Summary | Modes | Expected c_model header |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FEAT-NMU-AXI_SLAVE_PORT` | AXI4 full-protocol slave port (AW/W/AR/B/R): per-channel FIFO queuing, single-clock (no CDC in c_model). | Active, Passive | `ref_model/c_model/include/nmu/axi_slave_port.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NMU-ADDR_TRANS` | Maps AXI awaddr/araddr to NoC dst_id by first-match SAM range lookup and forwards the global address unchanged; the C++ model loads the topology YAML at runtime. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/nmu/addr_trans.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NMU-PACKETIZE` | Assembles AXI AW/W/AR transactions into NoC request flit streams (header + payload), tagging dst_id, src_id, awid/arid, flit_tail, and ordering_tag. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/nmu/packetize.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NMU-VC_MAPPING` | Maps outbound flits to a VC at flit-construct time (VC 0 at DAT_NUM_VC=1; REQ/RSP always VC 0), and stamps fixed_vc on the ordering_req=0 AW streak so routers keep that VC instead of restamping at VA. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/nmu/vc_allocator.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NMU-VC_ARB` | Round-robin arbitration across populated VCs at NMU REQ_OUT egress. Selects which VC's flit is emitted onto the NoC link each cycle, subject to per-VC credit availability. | RoundRobin | `ref_model/c_model/include/nmu/vc_allocator.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NMU-ROB` | Per-AXI-ID response handling on B and R paths. Disabled: admission filter (same-id different-dst stalls), responses pass in arrival order. Enabled: ordering_tag slot pool, in-order commit per ID. | Disabled, Enabled | `ref_model/c_model/include/nmu/rob.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NMU-DEPACKETIZE` | Parses inbound response flits into AXI B/R beats (with last) for the AXI slave port; reads ordering_req/ordering_tag to hand the beat back to the RoB. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/nmu/depacketize.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NMU-WORMHOLE_ARB` | Shared NI wormhole arbiter, 3 inputs (AW, W, AR) with the AW->W pairing lock: an AW flit (flit_tail=0) locks it to W until the flit_tail=1 beat drains, so AW+W stays one packet. AR never locks. | RoundRobin | `ref_model/c_model/include/ni/wormhole_arbiter.hpp` |

## NSU — Network Slave Unit

_Role_: NoC-side reception / AXI-side master

| Feature ID | Summary | Modes | Expected c_model header |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FEAT-NSU-AXI_MASTER_PORT` | AXI4 full-protocol master port (AW/W/AR/B/R): per-channel FIFO queuing, single-clock (no CDC in c_model). | Active, Passive | `ref_model/c_model/include/nsu/axi_master_port.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NSU-DEPACKETIZE` | Parses inbound NoC request flit streams into AXI AW/W/AR transactions before delivery to the AXI master port. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/nsu/depacketize.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NSU-META_BUFFER` | Snapshots request flit metadata (ordering_tag, src_id, awid/arid) on AW/AR flit reception; retrieved at response injection time to reconstruct the return path. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/nsu/meta_buffer.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NSU-PACKETIZE` | Assembles AXI B/R beats from the local slave into NoC response flit streams, using META_BUFFER for dst_id / ordering_tag / bid\|rid return-path reconstruction. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/nsu/packetize.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NSU-VC_ARB` | Round-robin arbitration across populated VCs at NSU RSP_OUT egress. Selects which VC's response flit is emitted onto the NoC return link, subject to per-VC credit availability. | RoundRobin | `ref_model/c_model/include/nsu/vc_allocator.hpp` |
| `FEAT-NSU-WORMHOLE_ARB` | Shared NI wormhole arbiter, 2 inputs (B, R), no channel pairing: every response flit carries flit_tail=1, so the lock engages degenerately and the stage is flit-level round-robin. | RoundRobin | `ref_model/c_model/include/ni/wormhole_arbiter.hpp` |

## ROUTER — NoC Router

_Role_: Per-node wormhole switch, one instance per physical network: REQ/RSP are 2-stage ready/valid single-VC SimpleRouters, DAT is a 3-stage credit Router with per-hop VC assignment

| Feature ID | Summary | Modes | Expected c_model header |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FEAT-ROUTER-ROUTE_COMPUTATION` | XY dimension-order route computation on the head flit; minimal, deterministic, no Y-to-X turns. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/router/router.hpp (route_compute)` |
| `FEAT-ROUTER-WORMHOLE_ARBITRATION` | Per-output packet-level lock ACROSS VCs, head grant to tail grant; RR advances per packet. A credit-starved worm idles the whole output. AW+W is the only packet whose lock spans cycles. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/router/router.hpp` |
| `FEAT-ROUTER-VC_ARBITRATION` | DAT only: per-output VC-major, input-minor round-robin, credit-gated, plus the VA stage assigning the output VC (preferred map + FVADA overflow) and restamping vc_id on fixed_vc=0 flits. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/router/router.hpp` |
| `FEAT-ROUTER-CREDIT_FLOW_CONTROL` | DAT only: per-(output port, vc) credit counters seeded with downstream depth, reserved at grant, registered 1-cycle return. REQ/RSP use an almost-full ready computed off occupancy. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/router/router.hpp` |
| `FEAT-ROUTER-MULTICAST_FORK` | A collective_op != UNICAST head takes the multi-hot route_mask_fork branch set instead of the one-hot route; each branch grants on its own, and the input pops once every branch has accepted. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/router/route_mask.hpp (route_mask_fork), router.hpp, simple_router.hpp` |
| `FEAT-ROUTER-COLLECTB_JOIN` | RSP only: a CollectB leaves unicast arbitration and is forwarded once, whole, when every route_mask_join input holds a head of that collect. BRESP precedence is first-SLVERR, DECERR never elevated. | — | `ref_model/c_model/include/router/route_mask.hpp (route_mask_join), simple_router.hpp` |
